name: io.github.Venut-Technologies/engine-dj-mcp
title: Engine DJ Library Assistant (unofficial)
description: Ask AI about your Engine DJ library: BPM/key search, audits, cues, opt-in playlist and tag edits.

packageArguments.description: Optional, off by default. The literal flag --allow-writes adds the five write tools (create and edit playlists; edit genre, comment, label, year and rating), with a full database backup before the first write of a session. Leave it out and the library is opened read-only and no write tool exists.
